title: POST /location returning 404 (test_sensors_location_no_post) conflicts with RFC 7252 + C cross-impl contract
description: python/tests/coap/test_lci_auth.py::TestObservableAuth::test_sensors_location_no_post asserts POST /location -> NOT_FOUND while GET /location on the same mounted SenMLLocationResource returns CONTENT. RFC 7252 mandates 4.05 Method Not Allowed for an existing resource that does not implement a method; 4.04 asserts the URI matches no resource. Cross-impl contract disagrees too: C coap_location.c sensors_location_post returns 401 (non-admin) / 201 (admin), never 404, and no vector in test/vectors/coap_lci_auth.json encodes a 404 location case; spec/appendix-senml.md defines /sensors/location as GET-only observable. Resolution needs either a test correction (expect 4.05) or an explicit spec decision to implement admin-gated POST semantics mirroring the C stack.
